Read the next-lowest file, `DifferentialPrivacy/Neighbours.lean`, in full (864 bytes, 2 hits): `inductive Neighbour` (Addition/Deletion constructors defining the neighbouring-lists relation) plus `theorem Neighbour_symm` with a complete tactic proof -- genuine core definition and proof.

No file matched a known exclusion pattern from this session's precedents (Verso-generated manual, generated data dump, CI/editor tooling, exact duplicate) beyond `lakefile.lean`; every `.lean` library file holds real theorem/lemma/def/inductive content.
